name: Walls.io Echo
description: Read and manage the authenticated user's Echo campaigns, their sharing visuals, their folders, and their analytics. All tools operate only on campaigns and folders owned by the connected user. Reference a campaign by its numeric id or slug, a folder or visual by its numeric id. Each campaign holds up to 10 sharing visuals, each with its own box_* element layout and its own sharing_url and sharing_text (empty values inherit from the primary visual at share time); the first visual (lowest position) is the primary one used when the campaign is shared. Add visuals by https URL (preferred) or base64, update their layout and sharing fields, or reorder them. Analytics tools accept an optional from/to date range (YYYY-MM-DD); omitting it returns lifetime totals (summary) or the last 30 days (timeseries/breakdown).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Walls.io Echo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Walls.io Echo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.echo.walls.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Walls.io Echo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walls.io Echo lists 16 MCP tools, including create-campaign-tool, create-campaign-visual-tool, create-folder-tool, get-campaign-analytics-tool, get-campaign-breakdown-tool, get-campaign-shares-tool, get-campaign-timeseries-tool, get-campaign-tool, list-campaign-visuals-tool, list-campaigns-tool, list-folders-tool, and list-organisations-tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Walls.io Echo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Walls.io Echo in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Walls.io Echo MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walls.io Echo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Walls.io Echo is developed by Michael Kamleitner. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
